title: docs(skills): objectstack-data teaches translating fieldPatches text in the patching package's own translations
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

Fixes #34785

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`objectstack-data` 技能的 `fieldPatches` 段落加了一句，说明补丁改写的标签、帮助文字、选项名由发补丁的包在自己的 `translations` 里翻译；另加一条评测用例。
- 为什么改：这个行为已随 PR #34784 上线，文档页也已写明，但对外发布的技能还没教，写元数据的 agent 不知道译文该放哪。
- 风险与回滚：纯文字，无代码、无 schema 变化；为付字数删了同文件三处重复表述。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`（新增的那句，以及「multiple: true lookup」提示块被删的后半段，风险最高）、`skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json`（用例 21）。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`，预期 `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md is 6665 tokens (ceiling 6665; headroom 0)`，整体退出 0。
- 需要你做的：无。`check-governed-merges` 判为 Tier H（`skills/**`），按低风险 skills 通道（2026-11-14 #33501 裁决）由席位落地：前提是本 head 有席位达档合同审记录，且写明 `Security-touching: no`。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`, the `fieldPatches` paragraph, gains one sentence after the example:

> Translate patched text in the patching package's `translations`, under the owner's keys (`objects.crm_account.fields.industry.label`, `.help`, `.options.VALUE`): the owner's translation of the replaced text never applies, a pair `.custom` translation comes first on `/meta`, and an untranslated locale serves the patch text.

(In the file the last key is spelled with the option value in angle brackets; it is written `VALUE` here so the body survives the sanitizer.)

Each clause was checked against the merged code of PR #34784 (commit `071323e1e7`), not only the docs page:

| Clause | Where the code says so |
| --- | --- |
| the patching package's own translations | `patchTranslationBundlesOf` in `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` reads `getPackageTranslationBundle(packageId)` per patching package |
| the owner's keys | `translateObject` in `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` looks the slot up with `lookupObjectFieldAttr` (`label`, `help`) and `lookupObjectFieldOption` (`options`) in the catalog `partCatalog` picks |
| the owner's translation never applies | `partCatalog` returns the patch catalog or the pair's for a changed slot, never the deployment catalog |
| the pair comes first on `/meta` | `patchCatalogsOf` lays the pair bundle over the package's; `form-routes.ts` passes no `pairBundle`, so the public form has no pair rank, which is why the sentence says `/meta` |
| an untranslated locale serves the patch text | no catalog hit leaves the served value as is |

`skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` gains case 21: a dependent package that already patches `crm_account` asks where its zh-CN strings go.

A root changeset, `@objectstack/skills` patch.

### How the new text is paid for

The file was at 6657 of 6665 tokens. The sentence adds 327 priced bytes; three cuts in the same file delete 295, and the row does not move. `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` is untouched.

| Cut | Text that still carries it |
| --- | --- |
| The lead-in line "Detailed rules, with incorrect/correct examples:" under the Quick Reference heading | The heading itself ("Quick Reference — Detailed Rules"); "incorrect/correct examples" stays in Naming Rules Summary |
| The multi-value-lookup note: the inline `{ type: 'lookup', reference: 'x', multiple: true }` spelling, and "It is NOT a junction table. Reach for a junction object (two lookups) only when the relationship itself carries attributes (role, added_at, …)." | The note's own title ("`multiple: true` lookup ≠ junction object") and the two Relationship Patterns rows above it: "Many-to-Many (simple): multi-value `lookup` (`multiple: true`), an array column of ids" and "Many-to-Many (with attributes): Junction object with two `lookup` fields". The positional-read sentence is kept |
| "`'organization'` / `'global'` —" in the pointer under the index example | The example block right above it: `unique: 'organization'` (unique per organization) and `unique: 'global'` (unique platform-wide) |

| Reading | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`, lines | 473 | 472 |
| `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`, tokens (ceiling 6665) | 6657 | 6665 |
| All 12 `skills/*/SKILL.md`, lines | 4730 | 4729 |
| All 12 `skills/*/SKILL.md`, tokens | 61622 | 61630 |
| The eval file (unpriced), lines | 367 | 386 |

## Tests

Text only; no package test applies and nothing was ablated.

<details><summary>Eval assertions, checked by script on ba3ed91491</summary>

For both JSON files under `skills/objectstack-data/evals/`: every `must_contain` token is a substring of its case's `expected_output`, no `must_not_contain` token is, and the ids are distinct. Result: 24 cases and 21 cases, 0 violations.

Case 21's tokens carry no whitespace or quoting (`translations`, `acme_billing`, `zh-CN`, `objects`, `crm_account`, `industry`, `customer`; forbidden: the key spelling `overrides:`, as cases 5 and 7 spell it, so a correct answer that says a pair translation overrides the package's still passes), because `packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/grade.ts` matches literal case-sensitive substrings with no normalisation. No token depends on whitespace, quoting or line breaks.

Left out on purpose: the placement itself (that the strings sit in `acme_billing`'s own bundle and not in HotCRM's files, and that the entry is nested under `objects.crm_account.fields`) cannot be told from a wrong placement by a layout-free token, so no assertion checks it. It is stated in `expected_output` only.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The claim's file surface names "the `fieldPatches` paragraph only" in `SKILL.md`. The three cuts are outside that paragraph; the dispatch order asks for the payment to come from restatement in the same file, and each cut is listed above.
- Not taught, to keep to one sentence: the same rule also covers `inlineTitle` and `relatedListTitle`, and with two patching packages the slot reads the package whose text it serves. The docs page carries the longer form.
- Noted, not changed: the sentence "Not the same key as object-level `ownership` …" in the paragraph above reads as if its subject was removed earlier. Not measured (shallow checkout), not touched.
- `skills/objectstack-data/evals/README.md` lists what each fixture covers and is not on the file surface, so it does not mention the new case.
- Open PRs #35022 and #33849 touch the same two files; `overlap-check` merges both cleanly. #35022 adds no case 21, and #33849 changes only the unpriced version stamp line.

## Verification

Head `ba3ed91491`, base `origin/main` 4443014630. Round 2 (contract review 6964628467, S1 and N1) changes only case 21's assertion tokens. On `ba3ed91491`: the eval script check above, `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` exit 0 with `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md is 6665 tokens (ceiling 6665; headroom 0)`, `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` exit 0 and `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` `VERDICT clean exit 0`. The other derived families were not re-run on this head (NOT MEASURED on `ba3ed91491`, reason: a two-line change to an unpriced eval fixture; CI runs them); the readings below are from `0b60aa4ce7`.

<details><summary>Derived gates: 48 derived, 46 exit 0, 2 NOT MEASURED</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 48 commands for the three paths. All 48 were run on `0b60aa4ce7`, exit code captured before any pipe:

- 46 exit 0, among them `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (and its `--self-test`), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-docs`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions`, `pnpm check:skill-links`, `pnpm check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `pnpm check:skill-compatibility`, `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync`, `pnpm check:doc-authoring`, `pnpm check:nul-bytes`, `pnpm check:published-files`, `pnpm check:dts-closure`, `pnpm check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`.
- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `pnpm check:lean-entry-closure`, both exit 3 ("Run `pnpm build` first"), reason: they need a full-repo build, and only the `@objectstack/lint` dependency closure was built here. CI runs them.

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: `48 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 46 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`.

Build: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@objectstack/lint...' build` under the verify lock, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

`node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: `VERDICT clean exit 0` against `origin/main` and PR heads #35022 and #33849.

Not run locally, declared to CI: `test:repo`, the repo-wide lint, the full dogfood battery (no `!` in the title, no narrowing arm).

</details>
